rows.note: This is the all-purpose modifier for non-biological things such as projects, technology, or plans that are still being developed.

example.english: This mobile app is still developing.
example.traditional: 呢個手機程式仲係發展緊嘅。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 sau2 gei1 cing4 sik1 zung6 hai6 faat3 zin2 gan2 ge3

rows.note: Use this instead of the general form when the developing thing is a person, foetus, or other living organism growing physically.

example.english: The doctor says a developing fetus needs enough nutrients.
example.traditional: 醫生話，發育緊嘅胎兒要吸收足夠營養。
example.jyutping: ji1 sang1 waa6 faat3 juk6 gan2 ge3 taai1 ji4 jiu3 kap1 sau1 zuk1 gau3 jing4 joeng5

rows.note: Use this before 國家 or 地區 for an economically developing or industrialising country or region.

example.jyutping: ni1 go3 hai6 faat3 zin2 zung1 gwok3 gaa1
